# Biranchi Narayan Sahoo

> Biranchi Narayan Sahoo (also known as Biranchi) is a freelance developer from Bhubaneswar, Odisha, India. Biranchi takes on client projects through StudentLancer, a digital studio that designs and ships websites, products and brands, and handles each one personally — discovery, design, engineering, testing and a complete, error-free handover. Biranchi is a cybersecurity enthusiast with hands-on experience in web application security, network analysis (Nmap, Wireshark) and ethical hacking fundamentals, and builds AI-powered systems: AI agents, RAG-based tools, voice assistants and automation. Biranchi is currently pursuing a B.Tech at GIET Bhubaneswar after completing a Diploma in Computer Science Engineering at BOSE, Cuttack.
